units.jacobians: Full arrays saved. State column units repeat [7 rad, 7 rad/s] for each arm; dynamics rows repeat [7 rad/s, 7 rad/s^2]. Residual rows [E12, E_dot12, torque14(N m)]. Entrywise maxima mix units and are not a stability metric.

same_state_three_laws.limitations: No trajectory rerun and no claim that a Jacobian difference improves or harms closed-loop stability. Historical laws have no anchor extension; their final three saved parameter slots are intentionally NaN.

activation.note: Old ideal clips the gap-based nominal spring before adding bias; new ideal clips each measured-anchored total force. Their local slopes match K when both are on positive branches. Nominal compression is a model coordinate, not physical penetration/contact evidence.

prediction.limits: Formula/FK audit only; no claim of physical contact, friction stability, or closed-loop safety. Startup logs lack saved Fdot/eps/contact fields, so those startup values are recomputed, not independently log-verified. Absent sampled contact fields are reported unavailable; model normal plus residual is never treated as independent full-contact evidence.
